plain: Loading, especially putting cargo on a ship.

webster.text: Loading; charging with a burden or freight; throwing or dipping out.

example.quote: That by "an act (11) to discontinue in such manner and for such time as are therein mentioned the landing and discharging, lading or shipping, of goods, wares, and merchandize, at the town and within the harbour of Boston, in the province of Massachusetts Bay, in North America," which was passed at the last session of British parliament;
example.cite: Thomas Jefferson, A Summary View of the Rights of British America, 1774
